blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Commercial property for sale in Coquitlam: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. This search shows properties for sale only; spaces for lease are not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
What sold across the Lower Mainland

Commercial Edge does not break out Coquitlam in the figures published on this site. Across the Lower Mainland, 285 commercial properties sold in the second quarter of 2026, worth $1,540.8M: 81 industrial, 56 land, 46 office, 82 retail and other, and 20 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Zoning decides what a commercial property can be used for. These are the Coquitlam zones on the zoning guide; each links to its permitted uses, smallest new lot and height limits. Check the zone of a specific address before you buy.

faq.q: Does this page show Coquitlam commercial space for lease?
faq.a: No. The search lists commercial property for sale only. For space to lease, call or text Jared at 604-928-1361 and he will pull the current lease listings for you.
